intent: Rename this repo's markdown onto the four shared namespaces (README.md / CLAUDE*.md / DOCS*.md / TODO*.md) and gate them, so a future session can tell a live task from a finished record without reading the file to find out.
scope: 40 markdown files renamed via git mv (history preserved)
scripts/check_md_naming.sh: thin shim delegating to kuhyx/utils
Non-goal: executing the outstanding work these TODO files describe
Non-goal: any change to source code, tests or build config
changes: Task files became TODO-<slug>.md and gained the literal line 'REMOVE ME AFTER FINISH'; record files became DOCS-<slug>.md with no marker.

Classification was by file CONTENT, not filename: RESTRUCTURE_HANDOFF.md and INSTALLER_FIX_TASK.md are settled records (DOCS), while docs/superpowers/plans/2026-05-01-phone-focus-recovery.md is still a task (TODO).
Deleted refactor_claude_todo.md and refactor_claude_todo_resume.md: the 250-line gate exits 0 in this repo, so the work they describe is provably finished.
Inbound references to the renamed files were rewritten in the same commit.

verification.evidence: exit 0; 0 problems across the whole tree
exit 0 -- the basis for deleting both refactor todos
71 passed; 100% branch coverage on the gate

risks: A rename breaks an inbound link not caught by the reference sweep. Mitigated: the sweep covered ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, rules/, skills/, memory/ and every tracked .md; a bare-basename match was deliberately narrowed after a dry run showed it would corrupt vendored node_modules files.
A doc classified TASK is actually finished, or vice versa. Mitigated: verdicts came from content audits cross-checked against repo code, and are recorded in ~/utils/md_naming/migrate/classify.py.
The gate depends on kuhyx/utils being present; CI checks it out, and the shim fails loudly with install instructions if it is missing.
rollback: git revert the commit -- every rename is a git mv, so history follows and the revert restores the original names.
After rollback, confirm bash scripts/check_md_naming.sh --all is no longer wired by removing the md-naming hook from .pre-commit-config.yaml and deleting .github/workflows/md-naming.yml.
